ChimeraX-AlphaLens

AlphaLens is a ChimeraX tool for inspecting AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 predictions. Like ChimeraX's own AlphaFold error plot, it shows the PAE matrix with a pLDDT track. It also shows:

  • predicted contact probabilities, on the plot and drawn on the structure;
  • the contacts in the model compared with the predicted ones;
  • how uncertain each predicted distance is (needs the distogram);
  • how many AF3 seeds or AF2 models agree on each contact.

It exports contacts to CSV. On Apple Silicon Macs and on Linux with an NVIDIA GPU, it can also run small predictions locally.

Contact probabilities for an AlphaFold2 prediction of E. coli SucC–SucD. Dots mark the inter-chain pairs with P ≥ 0.5.

Install

Requires ChimeraX 1.10 or newer, on macOS, Linux or Windows.

AlphaLens is on the ChimeraX Toolshed. In the ChimeraX command line, run

toolshed install AlphaLens

or choose Tools → More Tools…, find AlphaLens and click Install. Then restart ChimeraX. toolshed list shows the installed version; toolshed install AlphaLens version latest updates to the newest release.

To install a wheel from the Releases page instead, keep its file name and give its path:

toolshed install ~/Downloads/chimerax_alphalens-1.6.1-py3-none-any.whl

To remove AlphaLens, run toolshed uninstall AlphaLens.

Local prediction needs no separate install: the first time you predict, the button reads Install & Predict and sets up the engine. It needs Apple Silicon with macOS 13 or newer and the Xcode Command Line Tools, or Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU and the CUDA toolkit. See the prediction guide.

Quick start

alphalens open /path/to/prediction_dir          # top-ranked model
alphalens open /path/to/prediction_dir rank 2   # AF2 ranked_2, or the AF3 third-best sample
alphalens #1                                    # a structure that is already open
alphalens predict                               # local prediction

Or use the menus: Tools → Structure Prediction → AlphaLens opens a window for an open prediction (another window each time, while there are predictions without one), or asks for a prediction folder; AlphaLens Prediction opens the prediction dialog. Help in each window, or in its right-click menu, opens this manual in ChimeraX.

AlphaLens looks for the PAE file and the distogram next to the structure. It reads output folders from AlphaFold2, AlphaPulldown, AlphaFold3 and ColabFold. Most pipelines do not keep the distogram by default. Without it, you get the PAE view and, for AF3, the contact view. Tabs that need missing data are greyed out, and their tooltip says why. To keep distograms, see Getting a distogram.

Views

View Shows
PAE predicted aligned error
Contact probability probability that two residues are closer than 8 Å
Model contacts the model's contacts against the predicted ones: green in both, vermillion predicted only, purple in the model only
Spread uncertainty of the predicted distance (needs a distogram)
Agreement in how many AF3 seeds or AF2 models a pair is predicted to be in contact

Using the plot

  • Hover over the matrix to see a residue pair's values. ← / → switch views.
  • Zoom with the scroll wheel or a pinch, at the pointer. Pan with Shift-drag. Fit or Esc resets the view. The top right corner of the plot reminds you how. Zoomed in, the pLDDT track stays at the bottom of the plot, with residue numbers.
  • The contact probability slider sets the threshold for the dots, the 3D contacts, the agreement view and the CSV export.
  • Show Contacts draws the predicted contacts on the structure.
  • Click a dot to show that contact in 3D. Its values appear in the log.
  • Drag a box to keep only the contacts inside it, for example between two chains.
  • Model shows another AF2 model or AF3 sample of the prediction, another open prediction, or a prediction folder you choose, in the same window. For another model of the prediction, the contact lines, the clicked contact, the box and the hidden residues move to it, and Color pLDDT or Color PAE Domains colors it from its own data.
  • The hide slider next to the pLDDT track hides low-pLDDT parts. To hide a region, drag along the pLDDT track, then right-click and choose Hide selected.
  • Color pLDDT and Color PAE Domains color the structure.
  • Export CSV saves the contacts above the threshold.
  • The right-click menu has more options, such as color scales and Save image.
  • save mysession.cxs saves the plot with the session.

Local prediction

  1. Run alphalens predict.
  2. Paste sequences, FASTA, UniProt IDs or AlphaPulldown notation, such as P0A836:1-100+P0AGE9.
  3. Choose AlphaFold 2 or AlphaFold 3.
  4. Choose an alignment: an existing MSA, precomputed AlphaPulldown features, or a remote ColabFold search. The remote search sends your sequences to ColabFold.
  5. Click Predict. The result opens in a new plot.

To re-predict part of a complex, drag a box across an interface in the plot, then right-click and choose Re-predict selected interface…. The report compares the new prediction with the source, including DockQ.
